say:2:1029729001:1.text: Sinbad rushes over, out of breath, helping to subdue the shady Water Wights members.
say:2:1029729001:1.source_cn: 辛巴达气喘吁吁地冲了过来，正好帮你们把这些鬼鬼祟祟的水...

say:3:1029729002:1.text: That's odd. We shouldn't still be seeing Water Wights causing trouble like this.
say:3:1029729002:1.source_cn: 我正奇怪，现在不应该还有这样无故闹事的水鬼帮了。

say:4:1029729003:1.text: Sinbad, you said these aren't ordinary thugs?
say:4:1029729003:1.source_cn: 辛巴达，你刚刚说这些人不是普通的水鬼帮，是什么意思？

say:5:1029729004:1.text: Yeah! I saw them a few hours ago. They were just regular ship mercenaries!
say:5:1029729004:1.source_cn: 是的，我认得他们！就在几个小时前，他们还是普通的航船佣兵呢！

choice_prompt:6:1029729004.text: Yeah! I saw them a few hours ago. They were just regular ship mercenaries!
choice_prompt:6:1029729004.source_cn: 是的，我认得他们！就在几个小时前，他们还是普通的航船佣兵呢！

say:7:1029729005:1.text: You can think of them as hired armed sailors, bounty hunters, or guards—though their fighting ability and loyalty tend to be... questionable.
say:7:1029729005:1.source_cn: 唔，你可以当成是雇佣制的武装水手，赏金猎人，或者护卫队...
say:7:1029729005:1.male: You can think of them as hired armed sailors, bounty hunters, or guards—though their fighting ability and loyalty tend to be... questionable.
say:7:1029729005:1.female: You can think of them as hired armed sailors, bounty hunters, or guards—though their fighting ability and loyalty tend to be... questionable.

say:8:1029729006:1.text: I've been short on crew, so I've dealt with that crowd plenty. That's how I recognized them.
say:8:1029729006:1.source_cn: 我的船上最近人手不太够，经常要和他们打交道，所以认得这些人！

say:9:1029729007:1.text: Just a few hours ago, they came asking to board my ship, saying they needed to reach Rustport fast.
say:9:1029729007:1.source_cn: 说回正题，就几个小时前，他们想应聘我船上的水手岗位，要...

say:10:1029729008:1.text: I asked them a few questions, but they kept dodging. And this guy right here was the shadiest of the bunch!
say:10:1029729008:1.source_cn: 我盘问了两句，但他们遮遮掩掩的——尤其是你！

say:17:1029729010:1.text: Something felt fishy, so I turned them away and circled back here. Good thing I did!
say:17:1029729010:1.source_cn: 我本来拒绝了他们，但心里总觉得不对，就快速回航了——正...

say:18:1029729011:1.text: Tch... can't believe they changed outfits and posed as Water Wights in just a few hours.
say:18:1029729011:1.source_cn: 哼，没想到一会儿没见，这些家伙又扮成水鬼帮的人了！

say:19:1029729012:0.text: Could they be trying to sabotage the trade deal...?
say:19:1029729012:0.source_cn: 难道是要破坏商贸合作……

say:21:1029729013:1.text: More likely, it's aimed at me personally.
say:21:1029729013:1.source_cn: 不，我想这更有可能是针对我的私人恩怨。

say:22:1029729014:1.text: Expanding the trade network has earned me enemies. There have been attempts at interference.
say:22:1029729014:1.source_cn: 由于我开拓航路的计划动到了部分人的利益，所以经常有人试...

say:23:1029729015:1.text: But this guy might be a lead...
say:23:1029729015:1.source_cn: 这家伙或许是个突破口……

say:26:1029729016:0.text: I-I'm telling you, I am with the Water Wights! Honest!

say:28:1029729017:0.text: Ha! That's not what you told me earlier!
say:28:1029729017:0.source_cn: 哼，找我的时候你可不是这个态度！

say:29:1029729018:0.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, this guy's hiding something. We should give him a proper <style="highlight">interrogation</style>!
say:29:1029729018:0.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, this guy's hiding something. We should give him a proper <style="highlight">interrogation</style>!
say:29:1029729018:0.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, this guy's hiding something. We should give him a proper <style="highlight">interrogation</style>!

say:32:1029729019:0.text: Not really my area of expertise. Sonja, Lucca, if it's alright, I'd rather keep exploring the market.
say:32:1029729019:0.source_cn: 唔……审讯的事我帮不上忙，索尼娅女士，还有卢卡先生，还...

say:35:1029729020:1.text: Oh? Bold of you. Good. The Carmine Whispers appreciate that kind of nerve.
say:35:1029729020:1.source_cn: 噢？胆子很大嘛。不错，我们血薇帮也最喜欢你这样有勇气的...

say:36:1029729021:0.text: 那么，我们走吧。我会陪你们转一会儿，然后回去审阅报告。
say:36:1029729021:0.source_cn: 那么，我们走吧。我会陪你们转一会儿，然后回去审阅你的计划。

say:37:1029729022:1.text: I'll keep Rowan safe. I know these streets better than anyone.
say:37:1029729022:1.source_cn: 我会保护罗万，放心，这附近的道路我也很熟。

choice_prompt:38:1029729022.text: I'll keep Rowan safe. I know these streets better than anyone.
choice_prompt:38:1029729022.source_cn: 我会保护罗万，放心，这附近的道路我也很熟。

say:39:1029729023:1.text: If you find anything, keep me posted.
say:39:1029729023:1.source_cn: 嗯，如果有什么新情报，随时联络！

choice:38:0:1.text: Then leave the interrogation to me.
choice:38:0:1.male: Then leave the interrogation to me.
choice:38:0:1.female: Then leave the interrogation to me.
